old: 60 chairs are to be set out in equal rows. Use at least 2 rows and at least 2 chairs in each row. Count 6 rows of 10 and 10 rows of 6 as different ways. How many ways are possible?
new: A teacher sets out 60 chairs in equal rows. There must be at least 2 rows and at least 2 chairs in each row. Count 6 rows of 10 and 10 rows of 6 as different ways. How many ways are possible?
why: Sentence started with a numeral; passive/imperative wording made clearer

old: On a windy day, 20 kites were flown in a park. 17 of them stayed in the air for an hour. What percentage of the kites stayed in the air?
new: On a windy day, 20 kites were flown in a park. Of these, 17 stayed in the air for an hour. What percentage of the kites stayed in the air?

old: An apple orchard has 360 trees. 20% of the trees are new young trees. How many young trees are there?
new: An apple orchard has 360 trees. Of these, 20% are young trees. How many young trees are there?
why: Sentence started with a numeral; 'new young' redundant

new: Look at the picture. Two square tiles sit side by side, and a corner of each meets at point O. Equilateral triangle tiles fill the rest of the space around O, with no gaps and no overlaps. How many triangle tiles meet at O?

old: In the swimming pool, Leela swam four lengths in 5 minutes 10 seconds. Bela swam the same four lengths in 4 minutes 55 seconds. How many seconds faster was Bela?
new: In a swimming pool, Leela swam four lengths in 5 minutes 10 seconds. Bela swam the same four lengths in 4 minutes 55 seconds. How many seconds faster was Bela?

old: Factors come in pairs (2 × 6, 3 × 4). A pair has two equal numbers only for a square number, like 6 × 6 = 36. So only square numbers have an odd number of factors: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, that is 7 numbers.
new: Factors come in pairs (1 × 12, 2 × 6, 3 × 4). A pair has two equal numbers only for a square number, like 6 × 6 = 36. So only square numbers have an odd number of factors: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, that is 7 numbers.

old: Advait and Swati start together from the starting line of a 900 m running track and run round it in the same direction. Advait runs 150 m every minute and Swati runs 100 m every minute. After how many minutes are they next together at the starting line?
new: Advait and Swati start together from the starting line of a 900 m running track and run around it in the same direction. Advait runs 150 m every minute and Swati runs 100 m every minute. After how many minutes are they next together at the starting line?
why: 'run round' is informal; 'run around' is clearer
